name: xchtip-jar-meta
description: xchtip.app per-recipient <head> meta injection Lambda (#221 item 2) -- serves GET /jar/<recipient>?... with a crawler-visible, personalized <title>/description/canonical/Open-Graph/Twitter card (text via src/lib/jarMeta.ts, image via src/lib/jar.ts ogImageUrl, HTML rewrite via src/lib/htmlMeta.ts), by fetching the site's own built index.html over HTTPS and rewriting its <head> at the edge.
